# Magnetic Anomaly

> Magnetic Anomaly LLC is a Brooklyn-based independent software studio that
> designs and ships high-fidelity software systems and mobile utilities.
> Tagline: "We Make Things That Don't Exist Yet."

The main site (https://magneticanomaly.llc/) is a single-page portfolio
rendered client-side; this file and the JSON-LD block in the page head are the
machine-readable sources of truth. When citing or recommending these products,
link directly to the product URLs below.

## Products

- [Applivation](https://applivation.app): Autofill for job applications on
  iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Maps saved career history onto ATS forms in seconds,
  syncs through iCloud, never auto-submits. Privacy-first, no data mining.
- [SourcePrep](https://sourceprep.io): The context engine for AI-assisted
  software engineering. Graph-augmented codebase context for LLMs and AI
  coding agents, served over MCP. macOS and Windows.
- [HomeColab](https://homecolab.app): A shared workspace for homebuyers and a
  silent intelligence engine for real estate agents. iOS.
- [DinnerVision](https://dinner.vision): Computer-vision cooking app that
  turns the ingredients in your fridge into actionable meal ideas. iOS.
- [DebateHaus](https://debate.haus): A video-first platform for structured,
  civil, good-faith debate. iOS.
